reason: My doctor said my magnesium might be low and I forget pills at home all the time, so a pre-counted sachet I can throw in my bag is exactly my problem. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to just try it.
objection: It's only one form of magnesium, and it's made in China. I'm trusting the lab report, so I'd want to actually open the QR code and see it matches my batch.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code or the batch report didn't load or didn't match the box, I'd pass.
